descripcion_geo: City on the crest of a 335 m hill, capital of the Roman province of Asia; famous for its library and the altar of Zeus.
importancia_estrategica: Capital of the kingdom of Pergamon and seat of the imperial cult.

historias.titulo: Letter to the church of Pergamon
historias.descripcion: Christ praises the faithfulness of Pergamum but condemns the teachings of Balaam and the Nicolaitans.
Christ calls Pergamum 'where Satan's throne is', a reference to the altar of Zeus or the imperial cult.
Antipas is martyred in Pergamum for his faith; He is called a 'faithful witness'.

personajes.descripcion: He addressed the letter of Christ to the church of Pergamon.
Faithful witness who was martyred in Pergamon; name only mentioned in the Apocalypse.
Founder of the greatness of Pergamon; His successors bequeathed the kingdom to Rome.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: City of the altar of Zeus and the imperial cult; seat of the first temple to Augustus in Asia; scene of Christian martyrdoms.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Apocalypse calls Pergamum 'Satan's throne', interpreted as a reference to the altar of Zeus or the imperial cult temple.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Apocalypse calls Pergamum 'Satan's throne', interpreted as a reference to the altar of Zeus or the imperial cult temple.
